subject: Next steps: stakeholder playbook & commitment slate for OliveTech evaluation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: stakeholder playbook & commitment slate for OliveTech evaluation

Hi Priya — thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight playbook so we can align on the buying path and deadlines.

Call summary (30m):
- OliveTech scope: integrate Redwood embeddings + hosted inference for search ranking and summarization in pilot (10k users).
- Key success criterion: 30% improvement in retrieval relevance on internal benchmark; SLA target: median latency < 150ms for 512 tokens.
- Timeline: pilot sign-off targeted by end of Q2; procurement target week of 5/10.
- Initial blockers: SOC 2 evidence, data residency question for EU test data, and procurement approval process.

Suggested stakeholder playbook (draft MAP):
1) Economic owner: Daniel Rowe (CFO) — quick alignment call (15–20m) to confirm budget and contract term preferences.
2) Security & compliance: request intake to SSO/identity and SOC2 evidence — I attached a short evidence pack and a checklist.
3) Procurement: procurement@olivetech.com — need PO terms + standard redlines; propose an early review to highlight non-starters.
4) Technical champions: Priya (you) and engineering lead (TBD) — POC acceptance criteria and success tests.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Priya: please confirm the right procurement contact and availability windows for Daniel (economic owner).
- Marissa: can you own an initial draft MAP spreadsheet (I attached a template) and populate milestones we discussed?
- Ben: recommend we prep a 1-page SOC2 evidence summary and a short SSO architecture note for the security intake.

Attachments: OliveTech_MAP_v1.xlsx (playbook template), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (evidence index)

I'll hold a 30-minute slot for next Tuesday (3/23) at 10am PT as a working session to review the MAP unless you prefer another time.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@olivetech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Daniel Rowe <daniel.rowe@olivetech.com>, procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder playbook & commitment slate for OliveTech evaluation

Jordan — appreciate the clear write-up and the template. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Procurement contact: use procurement@olivetech.com (cc'd). They'll need the commercial sheet and a list of cross-border data flow practices.
2) Economic owner: Daniel is the right exec; I'll schedule a 20m intro for next week (his calendar opens Mon afternoon).
3) Security: we'll need the SOC2 Type II report and a short note on where logs are retained (retention windows). The security team also requested a short explanation of tokenization and how we handle PII in embeddings.

We can commit to a POC acceptance decision by 6/24 if the pilot meets the benchmark you outlined. For now, please surface any non-standard contract terms early — procurement flags change- of-control clauses and indemnity caps.

I'm good for the working session on 3/23 at 10am PT. If you can circulate a filled MAP before then, we'll use the time to align owners and due dates.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Singh
Senior Product Manager, OliveTech
priya.singh@olivetech.com | +1 (650) 555-2210

Subject: Re: Next steps: stakeholder playbook & commitment slate for OliveTech evaluation

Jordan / Marissa — quick internal note on the playbook items Priya flagged:

- SOC2 packet: I'll assemble a one-page summary (controls scope, auditor, date) plus the standard Type II redacted report. Use SOC2-evidence-request.pdf as the intake checklist and I'll drop the summary into the Drive link.
- PII/tokenization note: recommend we include an appendix describing on-the-fly token hashing and how embeddings are derived; this usually answers the security question quickly.
- Procurement redlines: standard exceptions we've seen — SSO/SCALING language, data residency commitments, and termination-for-convenience notice periods. Suggest we pre-draft a single-term sheet with preferred commercial points to accelerate procurement review.

Action items for 3/23 working session:
1) Marissa: populate the MAP spreadsheet with milestone owners and realistic due dates (Daniel intro, security intake, procurement review, pilot freeze test).
2) Jordan: craft a 1-page exec brief oriented to Daniel (budget ask + ROI bullets).
3) Ben: deliver the SOC2 one-pager and tokenization appendix to the Drive before Monday EOD.

I'll also propose we brief our solutions architect into the 3/23 call if Priya agrees — they can answer technical Qs live.

Ben Carter

Thanks all — confirming plan and the working session on 3/23 at 10am PT. Calendar invite sent to the group (if you didn't receive it, please let me know).

Deliverables timeline (agreed):
- Mon 3/22 EOD: Ben to upload SOC2 one-pager + tokenization appendix to Drive.
- Tue 3/23 10:00am PT: MAP working session — we will finalize owners and due dates.
- Fri 4/02: Daniel intro meeting to confirm budget range and preferred commercial structure.
- Pilot acceptance target: 2027-06-24 (PO required by week of 5/10 to meet internal procurement lead times).

Priya — when you schedule Daniel, please include a short bullet list of his priorities so we can tailor the 1-pager. Procurement — if there are mandatory contract clauses you need us to highlight, send a short note before Tue and we'll include in the term sheet.

Attachments referenced: OliveTech_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-evidence-request.pdf

Looking forward to the working session.
